enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Snore. Wake briefly. Turn over. Sleep. Stretch legs. Yawn. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs with fork. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs with spatula. Turn off induction cooker. Slide eggs onto plate. Take toast from toaster. Put toast on plate. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press kettle switch on. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag to mug. Stir tea with spoon. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing and packing bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes from closet. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Open bag. Put laptop into bag. Put notebook into bag. Put pen into bag. Zip bag closed. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Leave house. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: planning programs and coordinating with partners
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Make phone call. Talk to partner. Write program plan. Print document. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss program details. Coordinate with team. Update database. File documents. Respond to messages. Review budget. Prepare report.

Walk to nearby cafe. Enter cafe. Stand in line. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive sandwich. Find table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash. Stand up. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: meetings, scheduling and program administration
enriched_activities.desc: Return to desk. Check emails. Attend team meeting. Present update. Take notes. Schedule appointments. Call volunteers. Update program calendar. Review budget. Prepare report. Print documents. File paperwork. Coordinate with partners. Respond to messages. Organize files. Plan next event. Update database. Draft proposal. Review schedule. Confirm meetings.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Take off shoes. Put down bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat to pan. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Drain sink. Wipe counter with cloth. Put away clean dishes. Wipe stove. Throw away trash. Sweep floor. Mop floor. Take out trash. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room floor and tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture to vacuum underneath. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wind cord. Put vacuum away. Pick up items from floor. Place items on shelf. Fluff pillows. Fold blanket. Arrange cushions.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Get up to get snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Put on pajamas. Set alarm on phone. Plug phone into charger. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Turn to side. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Snore.
